levels.description:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP
<@ba.rem>On first skill activation, swaps the DP Cost of the Operator with the highest Cost (Prioritizes Guard/Caster/Sniper Operators) with the lowest in the Deployment Waiting Zone</>
<@ba.rem>'Eye of the Blizzard' is deployable when skill is active</>
